reports.rendered_content: The test performs a coverage analysis on a desktop-chromium configuration by opening Reference Settings, clicking the coverage optimizer summary, and analyzing results. It verifies that the drawer layout stays within viewport bounds, that 24,576 fine samples are reported, and that originB has 3 finite values with the second value less than 2.5 (ensuring props/rooftops do not become candidate platforms). It confirms existing panorama origins are never rewritten and no capture pair applies. In desktop-chromium specifically, after switching to joint-pair mode, it analyzes again and validates that both originA and jointOriginB contain finite values with a Euclidean distance greater than 1 between them, and that a capture element becomes visible.
